Figure AI built robots that can walk outside, and they already are
caption:
Figure's humanoid robots are no longer just walking around inside controlled labs. Spotted outside Figure AI's headquarters, these robots are navigating real outdoor terrain, uneven ground, open air, the kind of environment far harder to handle than a polished warehouse floor.

Most humanoid robots spend years in indoor test environments before they're trusted outside. Figure is already doing it casually, right at their front door.
